items.title: Craft Stick Scarecrow
items.alt: Crossed wooden craft sticks support a small scarecrow with a green felt hat, rust felt shirt, pale yellow scarf and raffia hands.
items.description: Crossed wooden craft sticks support a small scarecrow with a green felt hat, rust felt shirt, pale yellow scarf and raffia hands. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Felt Scarecrow Magnet
items.alt: A terracotta felt scarecrow face has a stitched mustard hat, mixed yarn fringe and a teal collar, with a separate round black magnet beside it.
